findings.title: Active system identification cannot identify the production two-store plant
findings.claim: SystemIdentification.identify() completes with a usable fit in 0 of 24 preset cells driven against the production ThermalModel, so _adopt_system_identification never admits a result, while a first-order control plant is admitted in 4 of 8 cells.
findings.mechanism: The step's heat enters the slab store; during RELAX the room rate stays positive at zero input and the first-order regression rate = -(UA/C)*dT + Q/C + G/C resolves that as a wrong-signed coefficient or an intercept outside the gains band. The comfort abort is also checked only at sample instants (0.92 C reached against a 0.8 C bound at the 30-min cycle).

evidence.machine: 8-core Apple M1, 8 GB, shared audit box
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: ten other auditors on the box (load1 3-73 during the runs); counts and deterministic simulation values only, contention-immune

perturbation.change: config slab_thermal_mass -> 0.5 kWh/C and slab_heat_transfer -> 5 kW/C on typical_slab (the harness's first_order_control cells)

findings.metric_definition: cells (preset x cadence x noise x bound) whose identify() result is completed with confidence >= 0.3, the _adopt_system_identification gate

null_control.note: positive control: a first-order plant is admitted in 4 of 8 cells with |bias| <= 8.06 %, so the harness can pass

reproduction_steps: read RESULT admitted_cells (0 of cells=24), aborted_at_production_bound (4), control_admitted (4 of 8)
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Identify against the two-store model: replay ThermalModel.simulate_step over the experiment window with UA and C_room free and the slab state carried (the house learner's per-interval replay, extended to the window); abort on the predicted excursion, not the sampled one.

findings.title: The defrost flag freezes the COP learner but not the fabric learners
findings.claim: A defrost-flagged interval in the frost band is rejected by _learn_measured_cop and ingested by _async_learn_house_heat_loss and _async_learn_lower_floor_loss, which replay the commanded power; on the two-zone radiator house house_heat_loss_scale reaches 1.0414 at 20 % defrost intervals and 1.0953 at 50 %.
findings.mechanism: The fabric learners replay the interval with the commanded electrical power through the model; a defrost delivers less heat than commanded and the shortfall is attributed to the heat loss coefficient. Only the COP learner consults DefrostWindow.peek(now).any_defrost.

findings.title: The accuracy tracker records through open-window and external-heat intervals
findings.claim: _record_accuracy skips AccuracyTracker.record only on a pump-signal freeze; intervals frozen for every learner by an open window or an external heat source are still recorded and feed _confidence_margins and temperature_bias().
findings.mechanism: The record call is guarded by self._pump_signals.freeze_reason is None only, while the lead-time scoring three statements earlier already uses _learning_frozen(CONF_INDOOR_TEMP_ENTITY).

findings.title: last_buffer_trajectory is a 5 SEK side channel with one poison
findings.claim: On a store configuration the terminal cost read through ThermalModel.last_buffer_trajectory moves by up to 5.42 SEK (7.1 % of the schedule's energy cost) if any simulation intervenes between writer and reader, silently; only the batch path poisons the attribute; today all four readers are adjacent to their writer.
findings.mechanism: simulate_trajectory / _with_dhw record the buffer trajectory on the model instead of returning it; _terminal_cost's closure reads it back as its fifth argument.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Return the buffer trajectory from simulate_trajectory and simulate_trajectory_with_dhw (four production call sites) and delete the attribute and the poison.

findings.title: coordinator.py has one cheap seam and no others
findings.claim: HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator is 10,269 lines / 256 methods / 174 instance attributes (132 multi-writer); its _init_* groups share 30.9 % of attribute references and 66.1 % of self-calls across boundaries, no clustering at k=6..16 gets cross-cluster attribute references under 0.33, and the only seam with cut cost under 40 is the manual-plan group (10 methods, cut 17).
findings.mechanism: Six hub attributes (_config 77 methods, _thermal_params 63, hass 42, _current_state 36, _opt_config 32, _current_action 23) are read from every functional group, so shared state, not call structure, binds the class.

findings.title: Five dead defs and six production functions only tests call
findings.claim: 5 defs (46 lines) are never started by the gate's scripts and never named in production or tests; 6 further production defs (140 lines) are started only because tests call them.
findings.mechanism: AST reference census (names, attributes, non-docstring string tokens over production, then tests) joined with a sys.monitoring PY_START sentinel over thirteen gate scripts.
